caption: A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
positive_analysis:
The taut chain linking the bulldozer to the dirt load transmits forward pulling force.
As the bulldozer advances, the chain drags the heavy dirt pile across the ground.
The dragged dirt load shifts and deforms along the terrain during movement.
physical_analysis:

negative_analysis:
If the tractor advances, the front blade will push the pile of dark soil across the muddy terrain.
The chains attached to the blade will remain connected and adjust tension as the soil pile is displaced.
The tractor's heavily treaded tires will sink deeper into the soft mud while exerting forward pushing force.
